scope: Italy university study and Norway higher-education study pathways
policy: Field-level primary-source evidence only; promotion requires complete material coverage and exact route alignment.

records.claim: Italy's Ministry of Foreign Affairs states that study visas include a route for enrolment at an Italian university and that applicants requiring a visa must obtain the applicable study visa for studies exceeding the relevant short-stay threshold.
records.sourceAuthority: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation
records.methodology: Direct review of current Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs study guidance

records.claim: Current 2026/2027 Italian diplomatic study-visa guidance states that applicants must demonstrate adequate financial means for subsistence; the published reference is €783.06 per month for the academic year 2026/2027, with financial circumstances considered alongside the minimum.
records.sourceAuthority: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs / Italian Embassy visa guidance
records.methodology: Direct review of current 2026/2027 Italian diplomatic study-visa checklist

records.claim: Norway's UDI requires applicants for a higher-education study permit to have been admitted to a university college or university and to study full-time; applicants must also satisfy the applicable housing and return-prospect conditions.
records.methodology: Direct review of current UDI study-permit guidance

records.claim: For higher-education study permits, Norway's UDI states that applicants must demonstrate at least NOK 15,488 per month or NOK 170,368 per academic year for living costs, with tuition funds required where applicable.
records.methodology: Direct review of current UDI study-permit financial guidance
